description: Patch a previously-logged retention offer event in place. event_id and date are immutable; everything else (offer text, scalars, outcome, notes) can be updated. Use this to fix missing offer_currency, clarify offer text, or update outcome if the call was re-escalated. Validation runs on the merged state — e.g., you can't update offer_type to 'points_bonus' without ensuring offer_currency is set. Changes are audit-logged in the event's metadata._updates trail. Prefer this over delete + relog because it preserves event_id and retention_history ordering.

card_id.description: The card ID the event belongs to

event_id.description: The event_id of the retention offer to update (from log_retention_offer response or get_card retention_history)

offer_currency.description: New currency key (required if offer_points is being set or already exists)

name: update_retention_offer
